run_evaluate_model_cli: run the TAP-3D model evaluation CLI to compute metrics on saved 3D track predictions
evaluate_data_source: evaluate data source by computing TAP-3D metrics on a set of 3D track prediction npz files
get_average_over_metrics: average per-video metrics across a list of nested metric dictionaries
get_new_hw_with_given_smallest_side_leng: compute resized image dimensions and scaling factor for a given smallest side length
get_jpeg_byte_hw: get image height and width from raw JPEG byte data
